verdicts.about: Look up the hidden zones only once the more-tlds toggle is opened
verdicts.why: The operator answered «да, хорошая тема» and the lazy lookup was built; the nine-row follow-up then refined where the lookups start, so it was not taken exactly as proposed.

verdicts.why: The operator said the docstring's promise is about the listed domain names, not about copy at all, so the proposal's frame was wrong; only the docstring was narrowed.

verdicts.why: The operator agreed («да, точно») and accepted the cost of a few extra lookups on a phone; the hook was dropped for a constant.
